definitions.explanation: A hand farming tool with a flat blade and a long handle, used to dig and turn over soil. Historically also a plow drawn through a field.

examples.japanese: {鋤|すき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{耕|たがや}す→耕す：03934_tagayasu⟧。
examples.english: I till the field with a spade.
Long ago, people had oxen pull a plow to till the rice fields.

examples.japanese: {鋤|すき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{掘|ほ}り{返|かえ}す⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: When you use a spade to dig the soil over deeply, the crops grow well.

notes:
A traditional digging and tilling tool. The word is also part of the dish name ⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧ (sukiyaki), said to come from cooking on a spade-like metal blade.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鍬|くわ}→鍬：08280_kuwa⟧: hoe — has the blade set at an angle to the handle for chopping into soil, whereas a {鋤|すき} blade is in line with the handle for digging
- ⟦スコップ→スコップ：08279_sukoppu⟧・シャベル: shovel — modern general-purpose digging tools
